learningObjectives: Identify the major components of the Ventricular System.
Explain how the Ventricular System contributes to distributed brain function.
Connect Ventricular System physiology with clinically relevant symptoms and conditions.
Interpret structural or functional findings cautiously and in context.

anatomy.label: Lateral ventricles
anatomy.detail: C-shaped spaces within each hemisphere containing choroid plexus.
anatomy.clinical: Enlarge with hydrocephalus or cerebral volume loss.

anatomy.label: Third ventricle
anatomy.clinical: Can be compressed or enlarged by nearby pathology.

anatomy.label: Cerebral aqueduct
anatomy.clinical: A common site of obstructive hydrocephalus.

anatomy.label: Choroid plexus
anatomy.detail: Specialised epithelium filters plasma and actively secretes CSF.
anatomy.clinical: Inflammation or tumour can alter CSF production or composition.
